text:
marta: Heads-up — planning to flip `autoscale_burst_v2` for a canary tomorrow 09:05 UTC. Canary audience: orgs with <=100 RPS labeled `canary-small`. Goal is to validate queueing improvements + max-concurrency guardrail. Any objections?
ryan: No objections from runtime. Suggest we cap `max_concurrency` at 8 for the canary and set `queueing_window_ms = 200`.
samir: +1. Also recommend adding a skiplist for internal traffic to avoid noise: `skip_if: headers.x-internal == "true"`. I'll add the rule.
devin: Ops note — runbook needs the rollback steps and explicit metric checks. I'll add a section and deploy a smoke alert. Ping me 10m before flip.
infra-bot: Canary target created: `canary-small` (10% traffic, region: eu-west, filter: org_size<=100).
ryan: Also enabling KV cache warming for the canary to reduce cold-start tokens. That should lower tail latency.
marta: Devin, can you add a smoke alert: p50 latency > 300ms OR error rate > 1% to trigger rollback?
oncall-jen: :thumbsup: I'll be oncall during the flip — add me to the incident channel and DM if anything looks off.
samir: PR is up: #3421 with the toggle change, small diff. Example snippet in the branch:
```python
feature_flags.toggle('autoscale_burst_v2', audience='canary-small', params={'max_concurrency':8, 'queueing_window_ms':200})
```
marco: LGTM, left a tiny nit in the PR. After merge, recommend scheduling the flip 5m after other platform work to avoid overlap.
marta: Agreed. Scheduling the flip for 1925003600 UTC (09:05). Devin — please update runbook and post a 20m reminder in #prod-deploys. I'll post the short announcement too.
devin: Will do. Runbook updated and reminder scheduled. I'll also attach rollback steps and alert thresholds.
